Name: New Ramp from Buss stop to Backwoods
Author: XPeterPants
Description:
This is a simple mod, all it does is add a new ramp so that you can travel from the bus stop to the backwoods(the area north of your farm) This is very useful when you accidentally went to the bus stop to go mining but remembered that using the backwoods is quicker. This is useful in early game but not useful late game because of the minecarts.

My first mod and I want to get your feedback :)

Installation:
- Have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed
- download this mod and extract it to your mods folder.
